title: Choose the visual world for the transcriber
question: The roll assigned Court Record. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Court Record
options.lineage: Stenotype paper tape and certified court transcript pages
options.thesis: Every video becomes a certified record: numbered lines, timestamp citations, a tape that feeds out as it listens.
options.viewport: Left: the Chrome tab as a docket header with one large Transcribe button. Right: a ruled transcript page with numbered lines and timestamps in the margin.
options.risk: Can read as legal-office stiff if the paper metaphor is decorative instead of functional.

options.label: Metro Tiles
options.lineage: Windows Phone / Windows 8 Metro typographic language
options.thesis: Giant lowercase words and flat colour tiles; the current tab is a live tile that flips to its transcript.
options.viewport: A black panorama: 'now playing' cropped off the edge, a big cyan tile for the Chrome tab, history as smaller tiles.
options.risk: Can feel like 2012 Windows nostalgia rather than a current tool.
options.case: Wins audience recognition on Windows; loses the transcript's document character, which is the product.

options.label: Gate Board
options.lineage: Boarding pass and airport departure board
options.thesis: Each video is a boarding pass; the queue is a departure board whose rows rerank in place as jobs finish.
options.viewport: Top: a pass for the current tab with title, length and a Transcribe stub. Below: a board of queued and finished transcripts.
options.risk: Shines with many jobs; most people transcribe one video at a time.
options.case: Fuses well for the queue and status; weaker for reading the transcript itself.

options.label: Datamatics
options.thesis: The audio drawn as a black-and-white barcode field that resolves into text as it is transcribed.
options.viewport: Full-width barcode of the waveform; transcribed columns light up as the model passes over them.
options.risk: Pure black-and-white strobing reads as art, not a tool, for non-technical people.
options.case: Fuses poorly because the general public needs a calm reading surface, not a data installation.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean modern utility app: sidebar, big action button, transcript pane, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Sidebar with history, main area with the current tab card, Transcribe button and the transcript below.
